dossier_meta.statement_text: Are unit segment graphs delineated (by twin-width)?
dossier_meta.context_text: The paper establishes that axis-parallel $H_t$-free unit segment graphs have bounded twin-width, while axis-parallel $H_4$-free two-lengthed segment graphs have unbounded twin-width, and that (triangle-free) pure axis-parallel unit segment graphs have unbounded twin-width. This places unit segment graphs at the frontier between delineated and non-delineated intersection graph classes, and the authors explicitly leave their delineation status as an open question.
